arguments.query: Every Method-2 interaction artifact of Model 2 is unverified, so no steel pole can ever be capacity-screened

report.title: Every Method-2 interaction artifact of Model 2 is unverified, so no steel pole can ever be capacity-screened
report.detail: Observed: structure_capacity_tables on m2-r18-planpolicy reports 35 of 73 capacity artifacts unverified, and every interaction (Method-2) artifact reachable from the project catalogue is among them -- the only two verified ones (ex-s-S800.012, m-c-NPD850d-2stay.012) are not catalogue members. structure_analysis_from_capacity_artifact blanks every loading condition of an unverified artifact, so the planner refuses those candidates for 'the capacity artifact represents no check for N supplied demand state(s)'. That refusal now also names the verification state, but the underlying gap stands: there is no workflow that produces the evidence set_capacity_artifact_verification needs, so an operator either verifies by hand with no receipt or the whole steel library stays unspottable. Expected: a documented way to obtain and record Method-2 verification evidence (the native 16.81 structure-usage report is the obvious oracle), and a report of which artifacts a project still needs it for. Acceptance: a project can state 'these artifacts are verified, by this evidence' once and spot steel.
report.blocked_on: Exact Model2 reviewed native signed-curve and75C/AfterCreep/assembly evidence, recorded once through DS; then successful steel spotting on that pinned model

latest_note.text: Installation is no longer the gate: current ds-server canary carries91648b08/2a26892c and exposes set_capacity_artifacts_verification plus structure_capacity_tables. No verification verdicts or designs were changed. Retained native-evidence audit keeps this report open:20 evidenced artifacts/105 partial percentages on a different Gisagara test model do not prove Model2; historical signed curve identities,75C/AfterCreep case and7 assemblies remain unmatched. Filed acceptance still needs evidence attached once and a successful Model2 steel spotting proof. This is qualification/acceptance work, not a justified new Rust change in this pass.
